document.title: Replace mattpocock skills with comprehende and pages, rewrite AGENTS.md
document.summary: The branch deletes the 21 mattpocock skills and their `docs/agents/` output, rewrites `AGENTS.md`, installs `comprehende`, and ports vitadeck's `pages` skill for hosted PR reviews. A separate part fixes four clippy warnings in `src/`.
document.why: Máté no longer uses the mattpocock skills and wants a concise `AGENTS.md` modeled on cigster, comprehende, and vitadeck [(session)](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 25
sources.gist: Remove the mattpocock skills and their artifacts, write a concise AGENTS.md based on cigster, comprehende, and vitadeck, set up cargo and keep everything valid, install comprehende since AGENTS.md uses it, port the pages setup, open a PR.

parts.name: Agent setup
parts.summary: The repo swaps the mattpocock skills for `comprehende` and `pages`, and `AGENTS.md` describes coomer and the new PR flow.

parts.name: Clippy cleanup
parts.summary: Four pre-existing clippy warnings in `src/` are fixed with no behavior change.

groups.title: AGENTS.md rewrite
groups.why: The old `AGENTS.md` pointed at mattpocock skill docs; the request asks for one modeled on Máté's other repos [(session)](source:s1).
groups.summary: `AGENTS.md` follows vitadeck's sections (Glossary, How it works, Footguns, Hit every surface, Verifying, Pull requests) and keeps the four existing coomer conventions under Taste.
lookFor: Footgun 2 says the pidfile is cleaned on every exit path, but `main.rs` already exits with code 1 when `app::run` fails after `replace_running_instance`, so a failed Display Capture leaves `~/.coomer/pid` behind.

groups.title: Remove mattpocock skills
groups.why: Máté no longer uses these skills [(session)](source:s1).
groups.summary: Every deleted file under `.agents/skills/` and `docs/agents/` came from `mattpocock/skills` or its setup skill, and `skills-lock.json` drops their 21 entries.

groups.title: Install comprehende
groups.why: `AGENTS.md` sends PR reviews through `comprehende`, so the repo installs it [(session)](source:s1).
groups.summary: `npx skills add matemolnar8/comprehende` wrote the vendored skill and its `skills-lock.json` entry, and `.claude/skills` symlinks to `../.agents/skills` so Claude Code finds it. You can skip the vendored skill text: it is an exact copy of the published skill.

groups.title: Port pages skill
groups.why: Hosted review links in PR bodies need the `pages` setup from vitadeck [(session)](source:s1).
groups.summary: `pages-review.ts` publishes a comprehende export to `pr/<n>/` on `gh-pages`, and `pages-reviews.yml` runs its `prune` when a PR closes and daily for sites older than 30 days. The script matches vitadeck except for the temp dir prefix and fallback git identity.
lookFor: `pages-reviews.yml` has `contents: write` and pushes commits to `gh-pages` from a daily cron. With no `gh-pages` branch, `prune` returns without pushing.

groups.title: Clippy fixes
groups.why: Setting up cargo showed four clippy warnings, and `AGENTS.md` now lists `cargo clippy --all-targets` as a check [(session)](source:s1).
groups.summary: `draw_session` takes the existing `RenderSnapshot` instead of nine arguments, which removes the identity `NSPoint` to `CGPoint` conversions in `overlay.rs`; three nested `if let`s become let chains.

commits.subject: Port pages skill for hosted PR reviews
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Copy the pages skill and its prune workflow from vitadeck so PRs can link a hosted comprehende export.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Install comprehende skill
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Install comprehende from matemolnar8/comprehende with the skills CLI and symlink .claude/skills to .agents/skills so Claude Code finds it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Fix clippy warnings
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Collapse nested if-lets and pass RenderSnapshot to draw_session instead of nine loose arguments.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Remove mattpocock skills and rewrite AGENTS.md
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Drop .agents/skills, skills-lock.json, and docs/agents. Rewrite AGENTS.md in the style of the other repos: glossary pointer, how it works, footguns, surfaces to check, verification, and PR rules.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
